description:
Use this when you need a broad national-scope reference count and regional or employer semantics are not required. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when the range needs a direct official authority, regional/local or employer calendar, or dates outside 2026-2028.
What it computes: Counts working and non-working dates in a 2026-2028 range using OpenWorkdays national-scope public-holiday data and country weekend rules.
Example user requests: Count broad-reference working days in Australia from 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-15.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); territory (enum); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-10-01","end_date":"2026-10-15","territory":"AU","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: normalized_start_date, normalized_end_date, working_days [working days], non_working_days [days], calendar_days_counted [days], public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, source_territory_name, weekend_days, working_weekend_day, holiday_names, holiday_observed, holiday_estimated, holiday_policy, calendar_scope, calendar_profile, substitute_day_policy, source_quality, dataset_version, coverage_start, coverage_end, source_url.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += reference status.is_working_day; non_working_days += not is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/global-reference-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/global-reference-working-days-between.md

territory.description: ISO-style alpha-2 country code supported by the pinned OpenWorkdays reference snapshot.

name: count_global_reference_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: National reference plus country weekend and explicit working-weekend dates.

holiday_estimated.description: True when an included event is marked estimated by the source.

holiday_names.description: Included national-scope public-holiday names on the date.

holiday_observed.description: True when an included event is marked observed by the source.

holiday_policy.description: National-scope events with source observed/estimated flags preserved.

non_working_days.description: Weekend and public-holiday dates. Unit: days.

public_holidays_counted.description: Source public-holiday events in the range.

source_quality.description: Open derived reference, not a direct national authority feed.

source_territory_name.description: Raw country name from the hash-pinned OpenWorkdays source catalogue.

substitute_day_policy.description: Source flags are preserved; no new substitute-day rule is inferred.

territory_name.description: Calcgrid display name; TW is displayed as 中国台湾省 while the machine code remains TW.

weekend_days.description: Weekend convention supplied by the source country file.

working_days.description: Reference working dates counted. Unit: working days.

working_weekend_day.description: True when the source explicitly marks a weekend date as an official working day.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Global Reference Working Days
